title: Awesome 3D Scene Understanding and Interaction
description: 3D scene perception and reconstruction, scene and asset generation, robotic manipulation, navigation, and embodied agents.

papers.title: Shape2Motion: Joint Analysis of Motion Parts and Attributes From 3D Shapes
papers.evidence: Jointly segments movable parts and estimates their motion attributes from a single 3D point cloud.
papers.link_notes: Repository identifies itself as the paper's code repository and includes train/test instructions.

papers.title: Category-Level Articulated Object Pose Estimation
papers.evidence: Estimates category-level articulated pose from a single depth image through part segmentation, canonical coordinates, and joint parameters.
papers.link_notes: The authors' repository calls itself the implementation of ANCSH and links its project page.

papers.title: CAPTRA: CAtegory-Level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects From Point Clouds
papers.evidence: Tracks per-part articulated pose online from point-cloud sequences and previous-frame estimates.
papers.link_notes: Repository identifies itself as the official PyTorch implementation and links the author project page.

papers.title: OPD: Single-view 3D Openable Part Detection
papers.evidence: Localizes openable parts and predicts their motion type, 3D axis, and origin from a single image.
papers.link_notes: Authors' project page and release.
papers.dataset_summary: OPDSynth and OPDReal provide synthetic and real observations with openable-part masks and motion-parameter annotations.

papers.title: OPDMulti: Openable Part Detection for Multiple Objects
papers.evidence: Extends openable-part segmentation and motion-parameter estimation to single-view images containing multiple objects.
papers.link_notes: Authors' project page and release.
papers.dataset_summary: OPDMulti provides multi-object images annotated with openable parts and their motion parameters.

papers.title: GAPartNet: Cross-Category Domain-Generalizable Object Perception and Manipulation via Generalizable and Actionable Parts
papers.evidence: Defines transferable actionable parts for cross-category part segmentation, pose estimation, and manipulation.
papers.link_notes: Authors' project page and release.
papers.dataset_summary: GAPartNet provides cross-category actionable-part semantics and pose annotations for interactive objects.

papers.title: Articulate3D: Holistic Understanding of 3D Scenes as Universal Scene Description
papers.evidence: Annotates indoor scenes with parts, connectivity, articulation, and executable USD structure, with scene-point-cloud prediction baselines.
papers.link_notes: USDNet is the official challenge baseline, not a claimed ICCV-method release.
papers.dataset_summary: Articulate3D provides part masks, connectivity, articulation, and interactable-region annotations for ScanNet++ scenes, together with a scene-understanding challenge.

papers.title: SAPIEN: A SimulAted Part-Based Interactive ENvironment
papers.evidence: Provides a physics-based, part-interactive simulation environment for articulated-object understanding and manipulation.
papers.link_notes: Official simulator project and source.

papers.title: ManiSkill: Generalizable Manipulation Skill Benchmark with Large-Scale Demonstrations
papers.evidence: Benchmarks generalizable manipulation across diverse objects in physics simulation, with large-scale demonstrations.
papers.link_notes: Current official framework and simulator repository; distinguish it from the original 2021 paper record.

papers.title: Ditto: Building Digital Twins of Articulated Objects From Interaction
papers.evidence: Uses visual observations before and after interaction to recover part geometry and articulation.
papers.link_notes: CVPR links the project; repository identifies released code.

papers.title: PARIS: Part-level Reconstruction and Motion Analysis for Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: Recovers part-level shape, appearance, and motion from multi-view observations in two states.
papers.link_notes: Author project and official implementation repository.

papers.title: Real2Code: Reconstruct Articulated Objects via Code Generation
papers.evidence: Reconstructs parts from visual observations, including multi-view RGB, and predicts articulation code from oriented bounding boxes using an LLM.
papers.link_notes: Official code repository found; no separate project page verified.
papers.section: Visual digital twins and executable structure

papers.title: S2O: Static to Openable Enhancement for Articulated 3D Objects
papers.evidence: Defines static-to-openable enhancement: part detection, motion prediction, and interior completion from static 3D assets.
papers.link_notes: Repository links project page and describes released code/data.

papers.title: REACT3D: Recovering Articulations for Interactive Physical 3D Scenes
papers.evidence: Converts static indoor scenes into simulation-ready interactive replicas through detection, articulation inference, completion, and assembly.
papers.link_notes: Official project page exposes code; repository labels source release.

papers.title: URDFormer: A Pipeline for Constructing Articulated Simulation Environments from Real-World Images
papers.evidence: Predicts a URDF from a single real-world image using localized part boxes and predefined meshes; supports simulation and policy training.
papers.link_notes: Official project and code release located.
papers.section: Visual digital twins and executable structure

papers.title: CAGE: Controllable Articulation GEneration
papers.evidence: Generates an articulated shape abstraction with geometry and motion parameters subject to category and graph constraints.
papers.link_notes: Project page links code/data; repository identifies official implementation.

papers.title: SINGAPO: Single Image Controlled Generation of Articulated Parts in Objects
papers.evidence: Generates plausible articulated assets from one resting-state RGB view while modeling geometry and kinematic ambiguity.
papers.link_notes: Use the ICLR abstract page rather than the broken PDF route from the intake check.

papers.title: ArtFormer: Controllable Generation of Diverse 3D Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: Uses a tree-token representation to generate high-level geometry codes and kinematic relations under text conditions.
papers.link_notes: Official repository found; no separate project page verified.

papers.title: Articulate-Anything: Automatic Modeling of Articulated Objects via a Vision-Language Foundation Model
papers.evidence: Uses text, images, or video plus retrieval and VLM-generated programs to create simulator-ready articulated URDF assets.
papers.link_notes: Official project and implementation repository located.

papers.title: Where2Act: From Pixels to Actions for Articulated 3D Objects
papers.evidence: Predicts pixel-level actionability, interaction trajectories, and success likelihoods for pushing and pulling articulated objects from image and depth input.
papers.link_notes: Author repository used by later official papers as the Where2Act implementation.

papers.title: FlowBot3D: Learning 3D Articulation Flow to Manipulate Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: Predicts a dense point-wise motion field from a point cloud and uses it to guide analytical motion planning for articulated manipulation.
papers.link_notes: Public repository names the RSS paper and contains package, scripts, tests, and pretrained directory.

papers.title: GAMMA: Generalizable Articulation Modeling and Manipulation for Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: Combines articulation modeling with grasp-pose affordance and adaptively updates joint estimates during manipulation.
papers.link_notes: Public repository documents data generation and training setup for GAMMA.

papers.title: UMPNet: Universal Manipulation Policy Network for Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: A single image-based policy uses self-guided exploration and a per-step Arrow-of-Time attribute for closed-loop articulated manipulation and state exploration.
papers.link_notes: Official project and public implementation repository.

papers.title: Vi-TacMan: Articulated Object Manipulation via Vision and Touch
papers.evidence: Uses vision to propose a grasp and coarse direction, then uses tactile contact feedback for precise articulated manipulation without an explicit kinematic model.
papers.link_notes: Project page and public repository use the same paper title.

papers.title: SAGE: Bridging Semantic and Actionable Parts for Generalizable Manipulation of Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: Maps language-grounded semantic parts to actionable parts, derives executable policies, and uses interactive feedback after failed action steps.
papers.link_notes: Official repository exists, but its README says 'Benchmark & Code & Instructions Coming soon'; do not present it as a usable implementation.

papers.title: ManipLLM: Embodied Multimodal Large Language Model for Object-Centric Robotic Manipulation
papers.evidence: Uses RGB and text prompts for affordance reasoning and end-effector pose prediction, followed by a closed-loop impedance adaptation policy.
papers.link_notes: Author project links the official repository. It includes data collection, training, and direct-pose inference; test code omits the paper's chain-of-thought inference and requires external foundation checkpoints.

papers.title: PointGroup: Dual-Set Point Grouping for 3D Instance Segmentation
papers.evidence: Groups points with predicted offsets and dual sets for 3D instance masks.

papers.title: Hierarchical Aggregation for 3D Instance Segmentation
papers.evidence: A bottom-up point-cloud instance method using point and set aggregation.

papers.title: SoftGroup for 3D Instance Segmentation on Point Clouds
papers.evidence: Uses bottom-up soft grouping followed by top-down refinement for 3D instances.

papers.title: Mask3D: Mask Transformer for 3D Semantic Instance Segmentation
papers.evidence: Uses transformer instance queries to predict semantic instance masks from point clouds.

papers.title: OneFormer3D: One Transformer for Unified Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.evidence: Unifies semantic, instance, and panoptic point-cloud segmentation in one transformer model.

papers.title: Point Transformer V3: Simpler, Faster, Stronger
papers.evidence: A scalable point-cloud backbone with released ScanNet, ScanNet200, and S3DIS experiments.

papers.title: OpenMask3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation
papers.evidence: Assigns open-vocabulary labels to 3D instance masks using multi-view images and vision-language features.

papers.title: OpenScene: 3D Scene Understanding With Open Vocabularies
papers.evidence: Transfers 2D vision-language features into 3D for open-vocabulary scene understanding.

papers.title: Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with 2D Mask Guidance
papers.evidence: Combines 2D masks with class-agnostic 3D proposals for open-vocabulary 3D instances.

papers.title: ConceptGraphs: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs for Perception and Planning
papers.evidence: Builds open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs from RGB-D observations for downstream reasoning and planning.

papers.title: PointNet: Deep Learning on Point Sets for 3D Classification and Segmentation
papers.evidence: Introduces a permutation-invariant point-set network for classification and segmentation.

papers.title: PointNet++: Deep Hierarchical Feature Learning on Point Sets in a Metric Space
papers.evidence: Extends PointNet with hierarchical local feature learning on metric-space point sets.

papers.title: Point Transformer
papers.evidence: Uses vector attention for point-cloud semantic segmentation.

papers.title: Point Transformer V2: Grouped Vector Attention and Partition-based Pooling
papers.evidence: Introduces grouped vector attention and partition-based pooling for scalable point-cloud understanding.

papers.title: PointNeXt: Revisiting PointNet++ with Improved Training and Scaling Strategies
papers.evidence: Studies training and scaling of PointNet++-style networks for point-cloud tasks.

papers.title: Large-Scale Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation With Superpoint Graphs
papers.evidence: Uses geometric partitioning and graph learning over superpoints for large 3D point clouds.

papers.title: Efficient 3D Semantic Segmentation with Superpoint Transformer
papers.evidence: Uses a transformer over hierarchical superpoints for efficient semantic segmentation of large 3D scenes.

papers.title: Stratified Transformer for 3D Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.evidence: Models local and long-range point interactions for 3D semantic segmentation.

papers.title: Towards Large-scale 3D Representation Learning with Multi-dataset Point Prompt Training
papers.evidence: Trains point-cloud representations across datasets with point prompts and releases its implementation in Pointcept.
papers.link_notes: The official CVPR PDF is live; the previously constructed HTML slug is not.

papers.title: ConceptFusion: Open-set Multimodal 3D Mapping
papers.link_notes: The official repository calls itself a WIP release and documents deviations from the paper; link it as released code with this caveat.
papers.evidence: Builds open-set multimodal 3D maps queryable by text, click, image, audio, or geometry.

papers.title: PartSLIP: Low-Shot Part Segmentation for 3D Point Clouds via Pretrained Image-Language Models
papers.evidence: Uses pretrained image-language models to support low-shot 3D part segmentation.
papers.link_notes: The author project labels this Google Drive release as Code. Do not replace it with the unrelated/nonexistent colin97 GitHub URL.

papers.title: ScanRefer: 3D Object Localization in RGB-D Scans using Natural Language
papers.evidence: Pairs natural-language descriptions with object localization in ScanNet RGB-D scenes.
papers.dataset_summary: ScanRefer pairs natural-language object descriptions with annotated objects in ScanNet scenes for 3D language grounding.

papers.title: MultiScan: Scalable RGBD Scanning for 3D Environments with Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: Provides RGB-D environments with object/part semantics and articulated-part mobility annotations.

papers.title: ARKitScenes: A Diverse Real-World Dataset for 3D Indoor Scene Understanding Using Mobile RGB-D Data
papers.evidence: Provides mobile RGB-D indoor captures and benchmarks for scene understanding.
papers.link_notes: The Apple repository supplies accompanying data-processing and training code; its canonical owner is apple-aiml-research after the apple/ redirect.

papers.title: ScanNet: Richly-annotated 3D Reconstructions of Indoor Scenes
papers.evidence: Provides richly annotated RGB-D reconstructions and benchmark tasks for indoor 3D scene understanding.

papers.title: A Large-Scale 3D Point Cloud Dataset for Indoor Scene Segmentation
papers.evidence: Provides large indoor point clouds and semantic labels used by room-scale segmentation protocols.

papers.title: Neural Implicit Representation for Building Digital Twins of Unknown Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: Optimizes part geometry, segmentation, and joints from two RGB-D scans in different states.

papers.title: REACTO: Reconstructing Articulated Objects from a Single Video
papers.evidence: Reconstructs general articulated objects from one video with rigging and motion-aware component modeling.

papers.title: PartRM: Modeling Part-Level Dynamics with Large Cross-State Reconstruction Model
papers.evidence: Models appearance, geometry, and part-level motion from one image plus user-specified drags.

papers.title: DRAWER: Digital Reconstruction and Articulation With Environment Realism
papers.evidence: Converts video of a static scene into an interactive environment with reconstructed objects and articulated doors.
papers.section: Visual digital twins and executable structure

papers.title: MagicArticulate: Make Your 3D Models Articulation-Ready
papers.evidence: Adds structure and motion to static 3D models and releases Articulation-XL2.0 data.
papers.dataset_summary: Articulation-XL2.0 provides articulated 3D asset data; MagicArticulate supplies methods for recovering structure and motion from static meshes.

papers.title: NAP: Neural 3D Articulated Object Prior
papers.link_notes: The author homepage links this current project URL and the repository. The repository is a usable preview with basic training/inference, not a full release.
papers.evidence: Uses diffusion over an articulation graph to synthesize articulated object models and conditional variants.

papers.title: Guiding Diffusion-Based Articulated Object Generation by Partial Point Cloud Alignment and Physical Plausibility Constraints
papers.evidence: Guides articulated diffusion with partial point-cloud alignment and constraints on penetration and joint mobility.

papers.title: Articulate AnyMesh: Open-Vocabulary 3D Articulated Objects Modeling
papers.link_notes: The author project explicitly labels its Code link as 'Coming Soon'; no usable official repository was linked in this check.
papers.evidence: Converts a rigid 3D mesh into an articulated counterpart using VLMs and visual prompts for parts and joints.

papers.title: Arti-PG: A Toolbox for Procedurally Synthesizing Large-Scale and Diverse Articulated Objects with Rich Annotations
papers.evidence: Procedurally synthesizes articulated objects with rich annotations for articulation-understanding data.

papers.title: LAM: Language Articulated Object Modelers
papers.evidence: Uses LLM/VLM collaboration to generate geometry and articulation code compiled into URDF.

papers.title: ArtLLM: Generating Articulated Assets via 3D LLM
papers.link_notes: Official implementation and model release are available. The repository includes preprocessing and training code, but detailed training/data-preprocessing instructions are still forthcoming; no ArtLLM dataset download was located.
papers.evidence: Uses a 3D multimodal language model and articulation data to generate assets from complete 3D meshes.

papers.title: PAct: Part-Decomposed Single-View Articulated Object Generation
papers.evidence: A feed-forward part-centric method generates part geometry and articulation parameters from one image.

papers.title: Articraft: An Agentic System for Scalable Articulated 3D Asset Generation
papers.link_notes: The author project explicitly redirects readers to articraftresearch/Articraft as the current repository for code and support; it supersedes the older Rook_articraft harness.
papers.evidence: Uses LLM-written domain-specific code to define parts, geometry, joints, and validation for articulated assets.

papers.title: Articulat3D: Reconstructing Articulated Digital Twins From Monocular Videos with Geometric and Motion Constraints
papers.evidence: Builds articulated digital twins from casually captured monocular video using geometric and motion constraints.

papers.title: VideoArtGS: Building Digital Twins of Articulated Objects from Monocular Video
papers.evidence: Targets geometry, part segmentation, and articulation for digital twins from monocular video.

papers.title: Articulation in Motion: Prior-free Part Mobility Analysis for Articulated Objects By Dynamic-Static Disentanglement
papers.evidence: Uses an interaction video and start-state scan for part decomposition, kinematics, and an interactive digital replica.

papers.title: ArtHOI: Articulated Human-Object Interaction Synthesis by 4D Reconstruction from Video Priors
papers.evidence: Uses monocular video priors and initial 3D assets for articulated human-object interaction synthesis by 4D reconstruction.

papers.title: Act the Part: Learning Interaction Strategies for Articulated Object Part Discovery
papers.link_notes: Official project provides paper and browser demonstration but does not link an author code release.
papers.evidence: Couples learned action selection with motion segmentation to discover articulated parts without semantic part labels.

papers.title: Learning Environment-Aware Affordance for 3D Articulated Object Manipulation under Occlusions
papers.evidence: Models point-level affordance with target geometry, occluders, and robot-position constraints; its official repository includes code and data instructions.
papers.link_notes: The author-labelled repository supplies code/data and points to a historic project page that currently returns 404; retain the repository and remove the dead project URL.

papers.title: Where2Explore: Few-shot Affordance Learning for Unseen Novel Categories of Articulated Objects
papers.link_notes: Author repository provides code and data; project page is linked from that repository.
papers.evidence: Uses geometric similarity to choose few-shot exploration interactions and transfer affordance knowledge to unseen articulated categories.

papers.title: FlowBot++: Learning Generalized Articulated Objects Manipulation via Articulation Projection
papers.link_notes: The author project links the repository, which calls itself the official code base; its public content is compact (part-embedding folder plus README).
papers.evidence: Combines dense articulation flow and per-point articulation parameters for zero-shot manipulation of novel articulated objects.

papers.title: FlowBotHD: History-Aware Diffuser Handling Ambiguities in Articulated Objects Manipulation
papers.evidence: Uses a history-aware diffusion model to represent multimodal articulation hypotheses under symmetry and occlusion.

papers.title: ArticuBot: Learning Universal Articulated Object Manipulation Policy via Large Scale Simulation
papers.evidence: Trains one policy in large-scale simulation for opening unseen articulated object categories and reports real-world experiments.

papers.title: A3VLM: Actionable Articulation-Aware Vision Language Model
papers.evidence: Uses an object-centric representation of articulation structure and affordance that can be converted to action primitives; the repository releases model and data-generation code.

papers.title: Tac-Man: Tactile-Informed Prior-Free Manipulation of Articulated Objects
papers.link_notes: Author project links this repository. It releases the paper's Isaac Sim simulation studies, not the complete real-robot stack.
papers.evidence: Uses tactile feedback for prior-free manipulation of articulated objects, including objects with complex joints and perturbations.

papers.title: CenterArt: Joint Shape Reconstruction and 6-DoF Grasp Estimation of Articulated Objects
papers.link_notes: First-author repository supplies data-generation, training, evaluation, and pretrained-weight instructions.
papers.evidence: Jointly predicts shape and joint codes to reconstruct articulated objects and estimate 6-DoF grasps from RGB-D scenes.

papers.title: UniAff: A Unified Representation of Affordances for Tool Usage and Articulation with Vision-Language Models
papers.link_notes: Author project links this repository. It provides annotation/rendering utilities and points to A3VLM for fine-tuning implementation, so it is a partial rather than end-to-end release.
papers.evidence: Defines a unified representation for manipulation affordances covering articulated objects and tools, with a VLM-oriented formulation.

papers.title: CheckManual: A New Challenge and Benchmark for Manual-based Appliance Manipulation
papers.evidence: Introduces a manual-based appliance-manipulation benchmark and the ManualPlan baseline; the author repository provides setup, articulated-object assets, and code.
papers.dataset_summary: CheckManual provides manual-based appliance-manipulation tasks, articulated-object assets, environment setup, and the ManualPlan baseline.

papers.title: ManiSkill2: A Unified Benchmark for Generalizable Manipulation Skills
papers.evidence: Open benchmark with articulation tasks, mobile and dual-arm settings, 2D/3D observations, demonstration data, RL, imitation learning, and planning interfaces.

papers.title: RLBench: The Robot Learning Benchmark & Learning Environment
papers.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters / ICRA
papers.evidence: Open large-scale vision-guided manipulation benchmark used for RL, imitation, multi-task, and few-shot learning; some tasks involve opening or changing articulated object state.

papers.title: BEHAVIOR-1K: A Benchmark for Embodied AI with 1,000 Everyday Activities and Realistic Simulation
papers.evidence: Household-activity benchmark and OmniGibson environment for long-horizon embodied tasks with dynamic object states; its current challenge documentation specifies a reproducible onboard-sensing evaluation protocol.
papers.link_notes: Proceedings publication year is 2023; the sixth CoRL conference took place in 2022. OmniGibson is the simulation environment accompanying this benchmark.

papers.title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
papers.link_notes: Google Research provides a self-contained tabletop implementation; it is not the complete original mobile-manipulator system.
papers.evidence: Combines language-model task planning with learned skill value functions to select robot actions that are both relevant and feasible.

papers.title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
papers.evidence: Uses language-model programs and 3D value maps to express and ground manipulation constraints in observed scenes.
papers.link_notes: PMLR identifies the correct proceedings identifier as huang23b, not huang23f.

papers.title: RPMArt: Towards Robust Perception and Manipulation for Articulated Objects
papers.evidence: Estimates articulation parameters and interaction points from noisy point clouds, then uses them to constrain grasping and articulated motion; the authors report synthetic-to-real transfer.

papers.title: Sim2Real²: Actively Building Explicit Physics Model for Precise Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.evidence: Uses a one-step interaction to construct an explicit object physics model, then plans a target joint-state trajectory with MPC; the released repository contains the three pipeline modules.

papers.title: Opening Articulated Structures in the Real World
papers.link_notes: Official project and RSS paper link the code. The repository targets the authors' Stretch RE2/ROS setup and requires external model weights.
papers.evidence: Uses opening novel articulated structures as an end-to-end mobile-manipulation testbed, integrating robot-centric perception, navigation, whole-body planning, grasping, and adaptation across real sites.

papers.title: SceneFun3D: Fine-Grained Functionality and Affordance Understanding in 3D Scenes
papers.evidence: Connects functional-element masks, affordance labels, task descriptions, and interaction motions in real indoor scenes.
papers.link_notes: The official code link provides the data toolkit and evaluation utilities; it is not a claim that every proposed baseline is implemented there.
papers.dataset_summary: SceneFun3D provides fine-grained functional-element masks, affordance labels, task descriptions, and interaction motions in real indoor scenes.

papers.title: Geometric and Semantic Coupling for Interaction Understanding in 3D Scenes
papers.evidence: Couples movable-part and handle predictions to estimate articulation and improve interaction-region detection in indoor scene scans.
papers.link_notes: The public implementation reproduces validation experiments; competition test scores use a separate challenge entry.

papers.title: ScanNet++: A High-Fidelity Dataset of 3D Indoor Scenes
papers.evidence: Pairs high-fidelity indoor geometry with registered DSLR and mobile RGB-D observations for scene understanding and novel view synthesis.

papers.title: Language-Grounded Indoor 3D Semantic Segmentation in the Wild
papers.evidence: Introduces a 200-category ScanNet benchmark and language-guided feature pretraining to study long-tail indoor semantic segmentation.

papers.title: DINO in the Room: Leveraging 2D Foundation Models for 3D Segmentation
papers.evidence: Projects frozen 2D foundation-model features into a 3D segmentation backbone, and also studies distillation for image-free downstream inference.

papers.title: Sonata: Self-Supervised Learning of Reliable Point Representations
papers.evidence: A self-distillation approach for point representations designed to resist geometric shortcuts and support downstream 3D perception through lightweight task heads.

papers.title: Volume Transformer: Revisiting Vanilla Transformers for 3D Scene Understanding
papers.evidence: Applies a minimally modified vanilla Transformer to volumetric patch tokens, paired with a data-efficient training recipe and multi-dataset supervision.
papers.link_notes: The author project links this official implementation. The paper is accepted to ECCV 2026 (Long Oral).

papers.title: Learning Context-Aware Classifier for Semantic Segmentation
papers.evidence: Learns a data-conditioned classifier that adapts to the latent feature distribution while remaining model-agnostic.

papers.title: OA-CNNs: Omni-Adaptive Sparse CNNs for 3D Semantic Segmentation
papers.evidence: Revisits sparse CNNs with adaptive receptive fields and adaptive relations for 3D semantic segmentation.

papers.title: OctFormer: Octree-based Transformers for 3D Point Clouds
papers.evidence: Uses octree attention with fixed-size local windows to make transformer processing scalable for point-cloud segmentation and detection.

papers.title: LaSSM: Efficient Semantic-Spatial Query Decoding via Local Aggregation and State Space Models for 3D Instance Segmentation

papers.title: SGIFormer: Semantic-guided and Geometric-enhanced Interleaving Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
papers.evidence: Uses semantic-guided query initialization and an interleaving transformer decoder that refines queries together with scene features.

papers.title: Superpoint Transformer for 3D Scene Instance Segmentation

papers.title: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation of Everyday Tasks for Generalist Robots

papers.evidence: Introduces a multiresolution hash encoding that makes neural graphics primitives, including NeRF scene fitting, substantially more efficient.
papers.link_notes: A general neural-graphics primitive framework included for its canonical scene-representation implementation.

papers.title: Mip-NeRF 360: Unbounded Anti-Aliased Neural Radiance Fields
papers.evidence: Extends neural radiance fields to unbounded scenes with anti-aliased rendering and an explicit distortion regularizer.
papers.link_notes: The representation targets image synthesis and depth structure from captured scenes, rather than semantic or physical scene editing.

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
papers.evidence: Represents a captured scene as optimized anisotropic 3D Gaussians with visibility-aware splatting for real-time radiance-field rendering.
papers.link_notes: A visual radiance representation; downstream semantics, topology, or collision geometry require additional modeling choices.

papers.title: Neuralangelo: High-Fidelity Neural Surface Reconstruction
papers.evidence: Reconstructs high-fidelity surfaces from RGB images through neural volume rendering without requiring auxiliary depth or segmentation data.
papers.link_notes: The author repository identifies itself as the official CVPR 2023 implementation.

papers.title: iMAP: Implicit Mapping and Positioning in Real-Time
papers.evidence: Jointly learns a scene-specific implicit map and RGB-D camera poses online from a stream of observations.
papers.link_notes: The author project page remains available. A previously circulated GitHub URL under the author account returned 404 in this validation pass, so no code release is claimed here.

papers.title: NeuralRecon: Real-Time Coherent 3D Reconstruction from Monocular Video
papers.evidence: Fuses monocular-video features into a sparse voxel representation to reconstruct coherent scene surfaces in real time.
papers.link_notes: The official project page links the author implementation.

papers.title: NICE-SLAM: Neural Implicit Scalable Encoding for SLAM
papers.evidence: Uses a hierarchical grid-based neural implicit representation for scalable online dense RGB-D SLAM.
papers.link_notes: The CVPR page and repository identify the release. The historical project-page URL reported by the paper returned 404 during this validation pass, so it is intentionally omitted.

papers.title: GO-SLAM: Global Optimization for Consistent 3D Instant Reconstruction
papers.evidence: Combines pose estimation, loop closing, and continuous surface updates to improve global consistency in dense visual SLAM.
papers.link_notes: The author repository labels itself as the ICCV 2023 implementation.

papers.title: SplaTAM: Splat, Track & Map 3D Gaussians for Dense RGB-D SLAM
papers.evidence: Uses an online RGB-D tracking-and-mapping pipeline with a 3D Gaussian scene map optimized by differentiable rendering.
papers.link_notes: The paper and project page identify the public code release.

papers.title: DUSt3R: Geometric 3D Vision Made Easy
papers.evidence: Predicts dense 2D-to-3D point maps from uncalibrated image collections, supporting camera recovery and dense scene reconstruction through global alignment.
papers.link_notes: The official repository provides code and pretrained models.

papers.title: Grounding Image Matching in 3D with MASt3R
papers.evidence: Adds dense local matching, metric point maps, and scalable global alignment to the DUSt3R reconstruction framework.
papers.link_notes: Naver Labs Europe lists the ECCV 2024 publication and official implementation.

papers.title: VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
papers.evidence: Uses a feed-forward transformer to infer camera parameters, point maps, depth maps, and 3D point tracks from one or many views.
papers.link_notes: The CVPR paper and author repository release code and models.

papers.title: D-NeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes
papers.evidence: Extends neural radiance fields with a learned deformation field for rendering non-rigidly moving scenes over time.
papers.link_notes: This reconstructs a time-varying visual representation and should not be read as recovering physical articulation parameters.

papers.title: MonST3R: A Simple Approach for Estimating Geometry in the Presence of Motion
papers.evidence: Estimates per-timestep geometry directly from dynamic scenes, extending point-map reconstruction beyond a static-scene assumption.
papers.link_notes: The official repository identifies the ICLR 2025 paper and code.

papers.title: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering
papers.evidence: Models a dynamic scene with a canonical 3D Gaussian representation and learned temporal deformation for efficient real-time rendering.
papers.link_notes: The author repository is linked from the public CVPR 2024 release.

papers.title: ATISS: Autoregressive Transformers for Indoor Scene Synthesis
papers.evidence: Generates indoor object layouts from a room type and floor plan, while supporting completion and object-placement constraints.

papers.title: SceneFormer: Indoor Scene Generation with Transformers
papers.evidence: Generates sequences of indoor objects, locations, and orientations conditioned on room layout, with a separate text-conditioned setting described by the authors.

papers.title: Graph-to-3D: End-to-End Generation and Manipulation of 3D Scenes Using Scene Graphs
papers.evidence: Uses scene graphs to jointly generate scene layout and object shape, enabling graph-conditioned 3D scene manipulation.

papers.title: DiffuScene: Denoising Diffusion Models for Generative Indoor Scene Synthesis
papers.evidence: Uses a diffusion model over indoor scene configurations containing semantic classes, object geometry, and placements.

papers.title: LayoutGPT: Compositional Visual Planning and Generation with Large Language Models
papers.evidence: Uses in-context LLM prompting to translate text conditions into layouts, including 3D indoor scene layouts.

papers.title: InstructScene: Instruction-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis with Semantic Graph Prior
papers.evidence: Combines a semantic graph prior with a layout decoder to synthesize indoor scenes from instructions.

papers.title: Text2Room: Extracting Textured 3D Meshes from 2D Text-to-Image Models
papers.evidence: Iteratively creates a room-scale textured mesh from a text prompt by lifting text-to-image outputs through depth estimation and inpainting.

papers.title: Text2NeRF: Text-Driven 3D Scene Generation with Neural Radiance Fields
papers.evidence: Combines neural radiance fields with text-to-image diffusion to generate view-consistent indoor and outdoor scenes from language descriptions.

papers.title: LucidDreamer: Domain-free Generation of 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
papers.evidence: Generates navigable Gaussian-splatting scenes from a single text prompt or a single image without a target scene domain.

papers.title: RealmDreamer: Text-Driven 3D Scene Generation with Inpainting and Depth Diffusion
papers.evidence: Optimizes a Gaussian-splatting representation through diffusion-based inpainting and depth guidance to synthesize forward-facing text-conditioned scenes.

papers.title: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image
papers.evidence: Expands a single image into connected 3D scenes while allowing users to specify new content and locations during exploration.

papers.title: SceneDreamer: Unbounded 3D Scene Generation from 2D Image Collections
papers.evidence: Learns an unbounded 3D scene generator from collections of 2D images, targeting large-scale visual worlds rather than an object layout alone.

papers.title: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments
papers.evidence: Uses language-model planning and a 3D asset collection to construct embodied-AI environments from natural-language requirements.
papers.dataset_summary: Holodeck constructs embodied-AI environments from natural-language requirements and a collection of 3D assets.

papers.title: ProcTHOR: Large-Scale Embodied AI Using Procedural Generation
papers.evidence: Procedurally samples diverse interactive 3D houses for simulated embodied-agent training and evaluation.
papers.dataset_summary: ProcTHOR procedurally samples interactive houses for embodied-agent training and evaluation.

papers.title: Infinite Photorealistic Worlds Using Procedural Generation
papers.evidence: Procedurally generates diverse photorealistic natural 3D worlds, including geometry, materials, and scene composition.
papers.dataset_summary: Infinigen generates procedural natural-world geometry, materials, and scenes for synthetic visual data.

papers.title: Infinigen Indoors: Photorealistic Indoor Scenes Using Procedural Generation
papers.evidence: Extends procedural scene construction to photorealistic indoor environments and provides an export path for real-time simulator use.
papers.dataset_summary: Infinigen Indoors generates procedural indoor scenes and provides an export path for real-time simulation.

papers.title: RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation
papers.evidence: Uses generative simulation to create tasks, scenes, and training supervision for automated robot-skill learning.
papers.dataset_summary: RoboGen supplies a generative simulation workflow for creating robot-learning tasks, scenes, and training supervision.

papers.title: Scenario Dreamer: Vectorized Latent Diffusion for Generating Driving Simulation Environments
papers.evidence: Generates vectorized traffic scenes and closed-loop agent behaviors for driving-planner simulation, rather than indoor manipulation.
papers.dataset_summary: Scenario Dreamer generates traffic scenes and closed-loop agent behavior for driving simulation.

papers.title: Visual Language Maps for Robot Navigation
papers.evidence: Fuses visual-language features into a spatial 3D map that can be queried with language for navigation goals and obstacle maps.

papers.title: VLFM: Vision-Language Frontier Maps for Zero-Shot Semantic Navigation
papers.evidence: Combines frontier exploration with visual-language goal recognition for zero-shot semantic navigation.

papers.title: LM-Nav: Robotic Navigation with Large Pre-Trained Models of Language, Vision, and Action
papers.evidence: Uses language models to name landmarks, image-language association to ground them, and a vision navigation model to execute long-horizon language instructions.

papers.title: LLM-Planner: Few-Shot Grounded Planning for Embodied Agents with Large Language Models
papers.evidence: Uses few-shot language-model prompting to produce high-level plans grounded through a low-level embodied controller.

papers.title: 3D-LLM: Injecting the 3D World into Large Language Models
papers.evidence: Augments a language model with 3D scene features for 3D question answering, dialogue, planning, navigation, and manipulation tasks.
papers.dataset_summary: The 3D-LLM release includes object- and scene-level 3D-language annotations and features for pretraining and downstream question-answering tasks.

papers.title: LEO: An Embodied Generalist Agent in 3D World
papers.evidence: Trains a multimodal agent with 3D vision-language alignment and vision-language-action instruction tuning across grounding, reasoning, planning, navigation, and manipulation.
papers.dataset_summary: LEO-align and LEO-instruct combine existing and synthesized multimodal examples for 3D vision-language alignment and embodied instruction tuning.

papers.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.evidence: Releases a vision-language-action model trained on robot demonstrations for language-conditioned visuomotor control and adaptation.

papers.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
papers.evidence: Provides a transformer diffusion policy and training code for language- or goal-image-conditioned robot control across multiple embodiments.

papers.title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
papers.evidence: Incorporates continuous visual and robot-state observations into a language model for embodied reasoning and control tasks.

papers.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
papers.evidence: Represents robot actions as tokens in a vision-language-action model to transfer visual-language knowledge to robot control.

papers.title: ALFRED: A Benchmark for Interpreting Grounded Instructions for Everyday Tasks
papers.evidence: Benchmarks language-guided household task completion through sequences of navigation and object-interaction actions in simulated environments.

papers.title: TEACh: Task-driven Embodied Agents that Chat
papers.evidence: Provides dialog-guided household tasks where an embodied agent asks questions and acts in a simulated environment.

papers.title: OpenEQA: Embodied Question Answering in the Era of Foundation Models
papers.evidence: Introduces open-vocabulary embodied question answering for episodic-memory and active-exploration settings in real scanned environments.

papers.title: Embodied Question Answering
papers.evidence: Defines an embodied question-answering setting where an agent navigates a 3D environment to gather observations before answering.

papers.title: Habitat 2.0: Training Home Assistants to Rearrange their Habitat
papers.evidence: Combines reconfigurable apartments, physics-enabled simulation, and home-assistant tasks for long-horizon mobile manipulation.

papers.title: Habitat 3.0: A Co-Habitat for Humans, Avatars and Robots
papers.evidence: Adds humanoid simulation, human-in-the-loop infrastructure, and collaborative social-navigation and rearrangement tasks to Habitat.

papers.title: GOAT-Bench: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal Lifelong Navigation
papers.evidence: Evaluates lifelong navigation to object-category, image, and language goals, including the role of scene memory across goal modalities.

papers.title: Vision-and-Language Navigation: Interpreting Visually-Grounded Navigation Instructions in Real Environments
papers.evidence: Introduces navigation in real scanned environments from natural-language route instructions and paired human demonstrations.
